analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: Sedatives act mainly on CNS GABAergic/benzodiazepine and related receptors, which are barely expressed in these non-neuronal cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other GABA/benzodiazepine receptor modulators, with muscle relaxants and opioids as weaker CNS-acting analogs.
